howItWorks.description: Urubuga rwacu ruraha umuntu wese uburyo bworoshye bwo kwandikisha, gukurikirana, no kugarura ibintu bye mu ntambwe nke zoroshye.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fungura konti maze wongeremo ibicuruzwa byawe ku rutonde rwawe rwa dijitali hamwe n'amafoto, ibisobanuro, n'ibimenyetso byihariye.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Buri kintu kirimo icyemezo gitekanye cya dijitali kigaragaza nyiracyo gishobora kohererezwa undi mugihe kinaniwe.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Kumenyekanisha ibintu byabuze cyangwa byabonetse byoroshye. Sisitemu yacu ihita ihuza raporo kandi ikamenyesha abantu bireba.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Vugana n'uwabibonetse cyangwa nyirabyo ukoresheje sisitemu yacu y'ubutumwa ifite umutekano kandi uhuze kugarura ibintu byabuze mu mutekano.
howItWorks.communityDesc: Urwego ruhujwe na bagenzi bawe mu kugarura ibintu rukwirakwira mu migi n'uturere

testimonials.subtitle: Umva ubuhamya bw'abantu batandukanye babonye ibintu byabo byari byabuze binyuze ku rubuga rwa KIZERE.

testimonial1.name: James Mutembei
testimonial1.quote: Natakaje mudasobwa yanjye ku kibuga cy'indege ntekereza ko yari yabuze burundu. Kubera KIZERE, hari umuntu wayibonye kandi ankubira telefone mu masaha make!

testimonial2.name: Florence Nkatha
testimonial2.quote: Uburyo bwo kwiyandikisha bwari bworoshye cyane! Nanditse ibikoresho byanjye byose by'ikoranabuhanga n'amabuye y'agaciro. Ubu numva nteyukanye kurushaho ibintu byanjye by'agaciro.

testimonial3.name: Robert Kabugi
testimonial3.quote: Nabonye umupaki w'umuntu kandi nkoresheje KIZERE kugira ngo mbonere nyirawo. Urubuga rwatumye bikorohera guhuza no kugaruraho umukono iicunga mu mutekano.

mobileApp.description: Porogaramu yacu ya telefoni igira ngo ubona lisiti y'ibintu byawe byanditswe, ukabasha kumenyekanisha ibintu byabuze cyangwa kugenzura ibyabonetse aho waba uri hose. Iboneka kuri iPhones na Android.

features.feature1: Gusoma kode QR mu bintu byabonetse kugirango habonerwe ba nyirabyo
features.feature2: Kubona amakuru mashya ahita ku bintu byawe
features.feature3: Kwimura nyirubwite byizewe mu buryo bworoshye
features.feature4: Gufata amafoto no kubika ibintu byawe by'agaciro aho uri hose

faq.description: Bona ibisubizo ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku bijyanye na porogaramu ya KIZERE.

security.question: Ni gute amakuru yanjye atekanye?
security.answer: Dukoresha uburyo bw'umutekano bwo ku rwego rw'ibanze mu kurinda amakuru yawe. Amakuru yawe abonwa gusa nawe n'abakozi babyemerewe mu gihe cyo kuyagenzura no kugarura ibyangirika.

items.question: Ni ibihe bintu nashobora kwandikisha?
items.answer: Ushobora kwandikisha ibintu byose bifite agaciro harimo ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, amabuye y'agaciro, impapuro, ibinyabiziga, ibiruhuko, n'ibindi. Ikintu cyose gifite nomero ikiranga cyangwa ibimenyetso byihariye.

lostFound.question: Gute porogaramu yo kumenya ibyabuze n'ibyabonetse ikora?
lostFound.answer: Iyo umenyekanishije ikintu cyabuze, cyandikwa muri databaze yacu. Iyo umuntu abonye ikintu, arashobora kumenyekanisha, sisitemu yacu ikabasha kuhahuriza raporo y'ibyabuze n'iy'ibyabonetse, ikabimenyesha nyiracyo.

limits.question: Ese hari igipimo cy'ibintu namenyekanisha?
limits.answer: Konti z'ibanze zishobora kwandikisha ibintu kugeza ku 10. Konti za Premium zifite ubushobozi butagira iherezo bwo kwandikisha n'izindi serivisi nk'inkunga y'ibanze n'isesengura rirambuye.
